# Switch

Switch models a persistent checked or pressed state with explicit ownership.

## Capabilities

- Binary value.
- Toggle.
- Idempotent set.

## Package availability

| Package | Import | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Core | `@sectile/core/switch` | Published |
| DOM | `@sectile/dom/switch` | Published |
| Terminal | `@sectile/terminal/switch` | Published |
| Vue | `@sectile/vue/switch` | Workspace preview |

## Usage

Import the public component subpath for the host you are building. Namespace imports keep the available state, events, controllers, and projection helpers together while the API is explored.

::: code-group

```ts [Core]
import * as switch from '@sectile/core/switch'
```

```ts [DOM]
import * as switch from '@sectile/dom/switch'
```

```ts [Terminal]
import * as switch from '@sectile/terminal/switch'
```

```ts [Vue]
import * as switch from '@sectile/vue/switch'
```

:::

## Supported scenarios

- Off.
- On.
- Controlled.

DOM and terminal scenarios refine the same semantic state. Host packages may expose different input and rendering helpers while preserving accepted transitions and controlled ownership.

## Interaction states

Component state that changes user-owned data supports controlled or uncontrolled ownership where listed above. Host projections distinguish disabled interaction from readonly inspection when the underlying control permits both.

## Semantics

The component contract follows [the relevant accessibility pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/switch/). Visual styling remains outside the package; use host attributes, parts, and state projections as styling hooks.
